rv.q: Commonwealth Shakespeare Company's A Midsummer Night’s Dream hits all the right notes.

Steven Maler, CSC’s founding artistic director, skillfully helms the hilarious production, where fun forest scenes with a grassy slide and ball pit were backlit by color-changing giant hearts from scenic designer Amy Rubin and lighting designer Maximo Grano De Oro.
Commonwealth Shakespeare's excellent production offers a wonderful opportunity to enjoy some of Shakespeare's funniest moments and most beautiful language under the stars.
Commonwealth Shakespeare Company’s A Midsummer Night’s Dream is a fun way to spend a summer evening under the stars.
Sometimes, this silliness is played up at the expense of clear storytelling.

cn.t: Critics praise this vibrant, well-cast production that captures the magic of Shakespeare's comedy in its outdoor Boston Common setting, with strong performances and vivid direction earning mostly positive reviews.
